_comment: Per-space sensory sheet for S-01 (lighting) and S-09 (audio). Supersedes the 'TODO' entries in data/world states.*.notes: copy from here into the room when you build it. 'reverb' is an Audio.set_reverb preset; 'surface' drives footsteps; 'tone' = layered room tone; 'sources' = point sources, each with a purpose (a clock, a hum, a cue); 'wayfinding' = the landmark the player navigates by (no UI); 'light' = key lights per state (night/day/dream/fire). Unreality detunes/doubles these further at runtime (docs/ART_BIBLE.md section 1). Add lines, never lore.

wi_living_room.tone: CRT hum (15 kHz whine, faint), dry heater tick, snow-muffled quiet outside
wi_living_room.wayfinding: the TV glow is the room's hearth

light.night: TV blue flicker (cool, strobe-free), one warm table lamp, blue shadow

wi_entry.tone: cold draught under the door, coat rustle
wi_entry.wayfinding: cold air and the front door

light.night: one porch light through the glass, amber on blue

wi_kitchen.tone: fridge compressor, faint drip, dishwasher ticking as it cools
wi_kitchen.wayfinding: warm light spilling into the hall

light.night: fluorescent ceiling tube, greenish, slight tick-flicker; stove light
bare bulb on a pull chain, yellow

wi_marysue_room.tone: aquarium pump hum, bubbling air stone
sources: fish tank pump + bubbles (stops being right after the tank is gone)

light.night: aquarium light (teal), nightlight (warm), desk lamp off

wi_yard.tone: wind in bare branches, snow creak underfoot, distant highway
wi_yard.wayfinding: porch light, the car in the drive

light.night: porch light, snow-bounce moonlight (cold); the 'sun' is wrong light from past the hedge

road_fork.tone: tyre hum, engine, wind at the windows
road_fork.wayfinding: headlights only; sign posts at the fork

light.night: headlights only, white; amber dash

road_straight.tone: long even tyre hum, engine drone
sources: Elsa's voice buzzing like a bee (from the back seat)
road_straight.wayfinding: the vanishing point of the beams

light.night: headlights only; the trees are a black wall at the edge

road_hills.tone: engine rising and dropping with the hills; suspension creak
sources: tyres lift: sudden silence in the air

light.night: headlights swing up to the sky on each crest

road_inn.tone: a single lit window, distant TV murmur, moths on glass
sources: murmur that is slightly too many voices
road_inn.wayfinding: the lit window (you are told not to stay)

light.night: one warm window and a buzzing sign; silhouettes face the road

road_trash.tone: night insects, rustle, the can rolling

light.night: headlight eyeshine, green-white

road_dawn.tone: first birds, tyre hum thinning, cooling engine tick

light.night: grey-blue dawn rising in the wrong place; a second brightness opposite

ext_path.tone: gravel crunch, cicadas already screaming, car engine ticking down
ext_path.wayfinding: the house growing at the top

light.night: hot dawn peach low sun, long shadows, headlights fading
light.day: white noon haze on the gravel

ext_clearing.tone: cicadas, grass seed rattle, heat, the forest holds its breath
sources: cicada chorus (stops at the house door)

light.night: low dawn sun, dry gold grass, black forest wall

ext_facade.tone: cicadas, shutters ticking in the heat
ext_facade.wayfinding: the front door under the porch

light.night: low sun on red brick, every window dark
light.fire: firelight orange on the brick from the slope

ext_forest_ring.tone: dense forest sound: wood creak, birds, then none
ext_forest_ring.wayfinding: the clearing's edge, never the way in

light.night: black trunks, a few shafts of low sun
light.fire: firelight picking out trunks, shapes between them
light.day: dappled noon through the trunks, then nothing

ext_shed.tone: tin roof ticking, dust, hot wood smell
ext_shed.wayfinding: the shed door beside the woodpile

light.day: shafts through gaps in the boards
light.fire: dark; a line of firelight under the door
light.night: dark; moon through the board gaps

ext_woodpile.tone: axe-chop echo, wood settle, whisky-sour heat

light.night: dark; moon on the stack

ext_slope_fire.tone: fire roar, spit and crack, flute out of tune, heat on the skin
ext_slope_fire.wayfinding: the glow, from every window of the house

light.fire: fire only: orange, flicker never strobing, heat shimmer; forest black behind
light.day: afternoon sun on bare grass before the pile is lit
light.night: dark slope; the fire begins the night
low sun through the posts

foyer.tone: huge quiet, a clock somewhere, the ring of every footstep
foyer.wayfinding: the grand stair and the chandelier

light.night: almost nothing; moon through the high window
light.day: honey light through the tall windows, dust motes

stair_hall.tone: a column of air, the dome far above, stair creak
stair_hall.wayfinding: the stair, the dome glass overhead

light.night: moonlight down the dome, a bright milk shaft
light.day: bright shaft from the dome, painfully clean
light.fire: orange flicker climbing the dome from the fire outside

bird_hall.tone: dirt-floor scuff, many tiny wing sounds, twigs, chirping, a dripping somewhere

light.night: pitch black until the switch; then the 12-arm nest lantern, warm green-gold flicker

dining_room.tone: cutlery, a clock, eggs sizzling next door, chairs scraping too far away
dining_room.wayfinding: the smell/sound of eggs and toast from the kitchen

light.night: dark; moon in the tall windows
light.day: big south windows: honey sun along the twenty-seat table
light.fire: firelight through the south windows, orange down the long table

kitchen.tone: pans, an extractor fan, a kettle, the back-stair door breathing
kitchen.wayfinding: eggs and buttered toast (Act 7); sounds through the pass

light.night: dark
light.day: morning-bright through small high windows, steam

pantry.tone: jar clink in a draught, very quiet

light.night: dark
light.day: one small high window, thin shaft

laundry.tone: drip, a wet-linen flap, a fan
sources: linen on the line flapping with no wind

light.night: moonlight on sheets

boot_room.tone: damp, drip, boots creaking in a draught

light.night: dark

west_back_stair.tone: tight stair creak, your own breathing, birds muffled behind walls

light.night: pitch dark; a thread of light under a door

gallery_north.tone: long wooden gallery: every step answers itself, high windows rattle

light.night: moon bars across the floor
light.day: honey bars from the high windows

gallery_east.tone: as gallery_north, warmer, a distant door latch

light.night: moon bars

gallery_west.tone: hollow, longer than it should be

light.night: dim moon bars

bridge.tone: a high open drop, air moving, chandelier crystals
bridge.wayfinding: the far side of the foyer

light.night: moonlit drop

portrait_west.tone: held breath; paint-and-varnish smell; the crowd in the painting almost audible
sources: a murmur you can only hear when you stop

light.night: dark
light.day: midday sun through the windows opposite the paintings

light.night: dark

master_bedroom.tone: hushed, a ticking radiator, bed linen settling
master_bedroom.wayfinding: the vast bed; seven pillows with the seal

light.night: dark; one big window the wrong colour

frank_room.tone: a boy's room: faint electric hum, a nightlight

light.night: nightlight

mary_sue_room.tone: quiet, a music box that is slightly flat

light.night: nightlight, warm

closet_suite.tone: fabric swallowing sound, moth flutter, the girl squirming then not

light.night: no light; the lantern's chirps are the guide
light.day: dim daylight under the door only

dome_stair.tone: your own breath, boots on stone, a rising hum like the sea in a shell

light.night: moon on the glass, silver-milk

dome_passage.tone: narrow, the stone ticking as it cools
dome_passage.wayfinding: the pale light at the end

light.night: a thin silver strip

dome_room.tone: huge clean silence, the glass warm and creaking, the moon like a presence

light.night: moon only: silver-milk, ink blue; the eye is the only saturated colour

military_gallery.tone: metal ticking as it settles, a mace swaying on a chain

light.day: warm spots on each suit; black background
light.night: dark; one bar of moon across the armour

bird_statue_room.tone: a ceiling fan turning, metal ticks

light.night: dark; moon on the sill, the birds only glints

sources: a low note that rises when you face a statue
gold_statue_room.wayfinding: gold glinting down the red carpet

light.day: red carpet, black walls, warm spots on 8-ft gold; the 3-ft loon in its own spot
light.night: dark; the gold takes no light

sources: a dress dummy creaking on its stand

billiard_room.tone: green baize hush, a ball ticking as it settles
sources: a ball rolling on its own, slowly

east_wing_upper.tone: cobweb quiet, torn tapestry flapping, decay creak, a metal tick as the pot warms
east_wing_upper.wayfinding: the great pot in the corner

light.day: grey shafts through broken blinds, dust

maroon_hall.tone: chandeliers humming, a child's footsteps ahead, the walls softening toward wood
maroon_hall.wayfinding: the child at the far end; the identical door

light.dream: ruby-maroon from sparse chandeliers, thickening and milky

kitchen_replica.tone: the right sounds, one beat too late; birds eating cake wetly; singing

light.dream: one ceiling fixture, 90s yellow-beige, no shadow where there should be one; candles

forest_corridor.tone: the hall becoming forest: footsteps change from carpet to dirt; chandeliers creaking in trees; a grackle

light.dream: barely past dusk, chandelier light turning milky, stars overhead

lake_shore.tone: glassy hush, reeds, a far grackle, no wind

light.dream: violet dusk, star-light, a pooled moon above and in the water

lake_canoe.tone: water lapping the hull, the line creaking, nothing else

light.dream: star-light and a pooled moon on glassy teal
